ctx.x: Who did you take lessons with then, when he went to Texas?

I didn't take... I, I, I, I played drum right on. And, uh, the same brother, with Brother T. I used to pull on the horn, and he came over to my house. And I was playing with him, and he was coming up all the time. The time you could look, you'd see him any time of the day you'd see him coming, you know, right there with me. You know.
